parsed_json.up: Select distinct compound ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the target CHEMBL4159. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary, filtering by target chembl_id CHEMBL4159 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Require structures via an INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
